sources.document_title: OPAx197 36-V, Precision, Rail-to-Rail Input/Output, Low Offset Voltage Operational Amplifiers
sources.evidence_extract: Retained SBOS737C, revised March 2018 (same bytes as the OPA4197IPWR owner). The package option addendum (physical PDF index 34, Addendum-Page 2) lists OPA4197IDR as Active, Production, SOIC (D) 14 pins, 2500 LARGE T&R, NIPDAU, MSL Level-3-260C-168 HR, -40 to 125 C. The pin configuration (index 3, printed 4) is headed "D and PW Packages: OPA4197, 14-Pin SOIC and TSSOP" with one pin-function column for both. Section 6.7 (index 6, printed 7) gives the full-temperature input-bias maximum +/-5 nA for packages other than PW.
Row C2058532, Texas Instruments OPA4197IDR, SOIC-14, expand library; stock 6533 and tier prices on 2026-10-31. Technical claims remain outside distributor identity authority.

sources.evidence_extract: TI OPAx197 Final 1.3 dated 23JUN2022 states the single core applies to OPA197, OPA2197 and OPA4197. It models open-loop gain and phase with RL/CL effects, output impedance, settling, slew, capacitive-load overshoot and large-signal response. TI states the model is an aid, provided as-is. Copyrighted model bytes are retained in the ignored local cache; the URL and hashes enable verified reacquisition.
